_readme: Corrections for decks whose FILENAME does not describe the document inside it.
These cannot be fixed by better filename parsing -- the archive itself pairs the
wrong name with the file, or the name predates a retitling. Every entry here was
confirmed by reading the document's own slides, and each records why.
Keys are the source_pdf path exactly as it appears in the manifest.
Recognised fields: title, speakers, conference_note, note.
`note` is written into the Markdown frontmatter as `content_note` so anyone
reading the file -- or retrieving a chunk of it -- sees the discrepancy.

Black Hat USA 2023 slides/Nan Wang & Zhe.title: Make KSMA Great Again: The Art of Rooting Android Devices by GPU MMU Features
Black Hat USA 2023 slides/Nan Wang & Zhe.note: MIS-FILED IN THE SOURCE ARCHIVE. The filename names a Chrome/JIT talk, but this deck is an Android GPU-MMU rooting talk by WANG Yong (@ThomasKing2014, Alibaba Cloud Pandora Lab): 89 mentions of Pandora Lab and 13 of KSMA against 5 of Chrome. Title and speakers here describe the actual document; source_pdf keeps the archive's filename.
